## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and link the issue, if applicable.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run verify:manifests`
- [ ] Documentation/README links checked when changed
- [ ] Manual Claude Code validation recorded, or explicitly marked pending

## Release and safety

- [ ] No original logs, credentials, or other sensitive output are included
- [ ] Version/manifests and CHANGELOG are aligned when release-facing
- [ ] Runtime algorithm/config/schema/retention changes are called out or excluded
- [ ] README English and Portuguese remain equivalent when user behavior changes

## Limits or follow-up

State unverified compatibility, E2E, CI, or administrative settings here.
